data: What is the approximate number of sentences selected by the dot-dashed line for the bin between 1700001 and 1800000?

The dot-dashed line represents the number of sentences selected by the FromAll data selection approach. The bin between 1700001 and 1800000 corresponds to the last bin on the x-axis. By examining the y-axis values for this bin, we can estimate the approximate number of sentences selected by the dot-dashed line. The value appears to be around 30000.
